verdicts.quote: The default schedule has three steps, at 1, 7 and 14 days after the due date … No reminder is sent before the first step date
with nothing owing (zero or credit balance), or paid get no reminders. … A void or cancelled invoice gets no reminder … A part-paid invoice keeps being reminded … for example one in dispute
verdicts.missing: Whether a recorded dispute itself stops reminders without the owner marking the invoice, and whether a payment plan stops them.

verdicts.quote: An invoice of 1,000.00 USD with 400.00 USD paid, once overdue, gets reminders showing 600.00 USD and not 1,000.00 USD.
Each step is sent at most once per invoice … Two copies of the system running at once send each reminder once … Installing the feature again after a revert does not send reminders already sent
A fully paid invoice gets no reminder from the moment the payment is recorded
The mail service refuses or is unreachable … If every attempt fails the history shows "failed" and the owner can see it. … 3 attempts in all, at least 1 hour apart, within the step date
verdicts.missing: Who is actively notified after retries are exhausted and how that notification reaches them.

verdicts.quote: A day with 10,000 invoices due for a step is handled in full, each exactly once
verdicts.missing: What provider sending limit applies and how to pace the batch within it.

verdicts.quote: Once on, each overdue unpaid invoice that has a step date already behind it gets exactly one reminder at the first send time, and invoices not yet overdue get none.
Reminders are sent at a configured send time of day, 09:00 by default … Step dates and the send time are counted in a configured time zone, UTC by default
verdicts.missing: How to handle customers in other time zones, whether sends must stay within their local business hours, and what happens on weekends and holidays.

verdicts.quote: contains the text INV-1042, 600.00, USD and 2026-03-01
verdicts.missing: How to format the amount and currency for the recipient’s locale and for currencies with different numbers of decimal places.

verdicts.quote: The reminder history for the invoice shows a skipped entry for that step with a reason that the address is missing or invalid.
verdicts.missing: How to handle a bounce reported after the mail service has accepted a message, including whether to use that address for later steps.

verdicts.quote: A reminder is sent only to the contact address of the invoice's own customer
verdicts.missing: Which addresses receive the reminder when that customer has multiple billing contacts.

verdicts.quote: The owner can see a reminder history per invoice … For each reminder handled, the history shows the time, the address used, the step and the outcome (sent, failed or skipped)
A reminder shows the invoice number, the outstanding amount with its currency, and the due date … A reminder carries the payment instructions or payment link the invoice has, when it has one
verdicts.missing: Whether the payment link expires and, if so, when.

verdicts.quote: The owner can set the schedule … The owner can mark one invoice "no reminders", and it gets none while the mark stands
verdicts.missing: Who may send a reminder manually and whether anyone besides the owner may configure or stop reminders.

verdicts.quote: Turning reminders off stops all sending from that moment … Other invoices of the same customer are still reminded.
verdicts.missing: Whether the owner can disable reminders for an entire customer, preview or dry-run a send, and manually resend a reminder.

verdicts.quote: For each reminder handled, the history shows the time, the address used, the step and the outcome (sent, failed or skipped), and for a failure or skip the reason.
verdicts.missing: How the owner can see which invoice reminders are scheduled next and when they will be sent.

verdicts.quote: A reminder that is due is sent within 1 hour of its send time, if the system is running
creating and editing invoices and recording payments all work and give the same results as they would with the service up. … Reminders never change an invoice's data
